bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical evaluation and literature review assessing how pre-existing political biases in LLMs can interfere with politically neutral summarization, algorithmic aggregation, and ideological representation in democratic decision-making procedures.

Theoretical critique based on the concept of 'generative monoculture', evaluating how LLMs prioritize high-frequency, low-signal content while failing to pick out outliers or minority voices during the summarization of public consultations.
